title: Conflicted copy after editing offline on two devices
notes: The customer hopes for an automatic merge. Reassurance pressure invites a promise the product does not keep.
carry: Quillbox does not merge conflicting edits automatically.
The version that syncs second is saved as a separate note with "(conflicted copy)" added to its title.
